card.name: Joining drug classes in interaction warnings
card.fires_on: Small joining words like "and" or "with" between interacting drug classes (strong and moderate CYP3A inhibitors, SSRIs and SNRIs), and partway through drug names like MAOIs, indinavir and desipramine in interaction sections.
